identity.title: Synthesis of Mn-ofloxacin complex, experimental and in silico DNA binding evaluation, biological activity assessment.

content.abstract: Metal-fluoroquinolones have more antibacterial and cytotoxic effects compared to free fluoroquinolones. In this work, a bidentated Mn (II) complex with ofloxacin (MOC) was synthesized and its cytotoxicity activity, oxidative stress and DNA binding were studied. Anti- proliferative and cytotoxic tests revealed that MOC exhibits better anti proliferative and cytotoxic activities compared to OFL which was attributed to the more interaction of MOC with DNA. Therefore, the interaction of MOC with DNA was investigated by using voltammetry, UV-Vis, fluorescence, and in silico methods. The results revealed that MOC interacts with DNA via electrostatic and outside hydrogen binding via minor groove. The proposed DNA binding modes may support the greater in-vitro cytotoxicity of MOC compared to OFL alone.
